title: Bob Maguire measures his girlfriend's implant with an RF detector

tellings.quote: Cuz I I just interviewed Bob Maguire whose girlfriend uh has an implant and he put like an RF detector over her head and can like measure the frequency coming out.
I have a video online of me moving this field meter across her head and watching that implant pul RF Transmissions
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by McGwier, who says the implant sends out pulses and that he has a video of it online; the story's telling is the host's secondhand account of measuring the frequency.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe Bob McGwier measuring his girlfriend's head implant with an RF meter and seeing it transmit.

as_told.title: Girlfriend's forehead implant pulses RF transmissions

plain: A former CIA contractor named Bob McGwier says his girlfriend has an implant in her head and that he has measured radio signals coming from it. He tells it first-hand: "I have a video online of me moving this field meter across her head and watching that implant pul RF Transmissions." A field meter, or RF detector, is a device that picks up radio waves. In the subject, an implant usually means a small object people say was placed in their body during an encounter with something unknown. Michels later retells it to the author Whitley Strieber. He spells the name Bob Maguire and says McGwier could "measure the frequency coming out". The host's version is second-hand and comes from his own interview with McGwier. If true, the implant would be a physical object that sends out signals you can measure.
